# spaceman oidc

Single sign-on: OIDC providers and group mappings.

Aliases: `sso`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman oidc mapping`](#spaceman-oidc-mapping) | Group mappings: a groups-claim value grants a role in a domain at every SSO sign-in |
| [`spaceman oidc provider`](#spaceman-oidc-provider) | OIDC sign-in providers: list, show, create, update, delete and the test-login preview |
| [`spaceman oidc sign-in-providers`](#spaceman-oidc-sign-in-providers) | Providers offered on the sign-in page (needs no token) |

## spaceman oidc mapping

Group mappings: a groups-claim value grants a role in a domain at every SSO sign-in.

Aliases: `mappings`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman oidc mapping add`](#spaceman-oidc-mapping-add) | Map a groups-claim value to a role in a domain |
| [`spaceman oidc mapping delete`](#spaceman-oidc-mapping-delete) | Remove a group mapping |
| [`spaceman oidc mapping list`](#spaceman-oidc-mapping-list) | A provider's group mappings |

## spaceman oidc mapping add

Map a groups-claim value to a role in a domain.

```sh
spaceman oidc mapping add <provider> [flags]
```

API: `add-oidc-mapping` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman oidc mapping add porch --group payments-oncall --role operator --domain payments
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--domain` | string |  | space ID or slug, or * for every space and global administration (required) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--group` | string |  | groups-claim value (required) |
| `--role` | string |  | viewer, operator or admin (required) |

## spaceman oidc mapping delete

Remove a group mapping.

```sh
spaceman oidc mapping delete <provider> <mapping> [flags]
```

API: `delete-oidc-mapping` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman oidc mapping list

A provider's group mappings.

```sh

```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-oidc-mappings` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman oidc provider create

Add an OIDC provider; the client secret comes from a file or standard input.

Discovery runs at the first sign-in. Sign in once through the provider's test login in the web UI and check the claim mapping with `spaceman oidc provider test-login` before enabling it.

```sh
spaceman oidc provider create <slug> [flags]
```

API: `create-oidc-provider` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman oidc provider create porch --display-name Porch --issuer https://porch.example.com --client-id spaceman \
  --client-secret-file ./porch.secret --scope openid,profile,email,groups --groups-claim groups
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--acr-value` | string, repeatable |  | acr_values to request (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--allow-cross-origin-endpoints` | bool |  | allow endpoints on another origin than the issuer |
| `--allow-private-network` | bool |  | allow a private-network issuer |
| `--ca-bundle-file` | string |  | PEM file of the CAs that sign the issuer's certificates |
| `--client-id` | string |  | client ID |
| `--client-secret-file` | string |  | client secret (sealed; never readable again) (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--client-secret-stdin` | bool |  | read --client-secret-file's value from standard input instead |
| `--display-name` | string |  | name on the sign-in page |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | offer it on the sign-in page |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--groups-claim` | string |  | claim holding the user's groups |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--issuer` | string |  | issuer URL |
| `--jit-file` | string |  | just-in-time provisioning rules (JSON or YAML file) |
| `--provisioning` | string |  | preprovisioned or jit |
| `--scope` | string, repeatable |  | scope to request (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--stepup-fallback` | string |  | none or local_totp |

## spaceman oidc provider test-login

Your latest test login's claim-mapping preview.

The test login itself runs in the browser (it is a sign-in); this shows what it found.

```sh
spaceman oidc provider test-login <provider> [flags]
```

API: `get-oidc-test-login` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman oidc provider update

Change an OIDC provider (only the flags given change).

Changing the issuer or client ID clears the test-login evidence. --client-secret-file replaces the secret; --remove-client-secret deletes it.

```sh
spaceman oidc provider update <provider> [flags]
```

API: `get-oidc-provider`, `update-oidc-provider` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--acr-value` | string, repeatable |  | acr_values to request (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--allow-cross-origin-endpoints` | bool |  | allow endpoints on another origin than the issuer |
| `--allow-private-network` | bool |  | allow a private-network issuer |
| `--ca-bundle-file` | string |  | PEM file of the CAs that sign the issuer's certificates |
| `--client-id` | string |  | client ID |
| `--client-secret-file` | string |  | client secret (sealed; never readable again) (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--client-secret-stdin` | bool |  | read --client-secret-file's value from standard input instead |
| `--display-name` | string |  | name on the sign-in page |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | offer it on the sign-in page |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--groups-claim` | string |  | claim holding the user's groups |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--issuer` | string |  | issuer URL |
| `--jit-file` | string |  | just-in-time provisioning rules (JSON or YAML file) |
| `--provisioning` | string |  | preprovisioned or jit |
| `--remove-client-secret` | bool |  | delete the stored client secret |
| `--scope` | string, repeatable |  | scope to request (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--stepup-fallback` | string |  | none or local_totp |
